issues.description: The return type of Farm.singFarmSong() is inconsistent across artifacts: the UML and template indicate a void method (prints the song), but the provided solution implements singFarmSong() as returning String. This mismatch can confuse students about whether they should print the song (void) or return it (String) and can cause tests or starter code expectations to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the signature consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) change the solution to implement public void singFarmSong() and print the song (matching the UML/template), or (B) update the UML and template method signature to public String singFarmSong() and adjust template/tests to expect a returned String. Prefer one consistent API across problem statement, template, and tests.

issues.description: The helper method singFarmSongVerse has mismatched parameter and return semantics: the UML and template declare a private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal) (prints a verse), but the solution implements private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal) (returns a verse string). The template currently has the animal parameter commented out, which could be pedagogical, but the differing return type (void vs String) between solution and the specification/template is a structural mismatch that may confuse students.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the helper method signature across all artifacts. Either: (A) make singFarmSongVerse accept an Animal and return void (and print the verse) in the solution to match the UML/template, or (B) update the UML and template to declare singFarmSongVerse(Animal):String (and document that singFarmSong concatenates/returns the full song). Ensure template code includes the Animal parameter (not commented out) if returning/using it.
